items.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: So he gave me a break. His name was Proctor. Warrant Officer Proctor.

ctx.x: Oh, okay. Now we have to backtrack and we’ll talk about the music, but this is very interesting.

Okay, well I played the tuba and there was a warrant officer in there that heard me play, and my tone was very good, and I could play the chromatic scale and the B flat major scale and my reading was down a little bit. And he says, “your reading is not good but you have a very good tone.” He says, “I’ll give you six months to come up to par.” So he gave me a break. His name was Proctor. Warrant Officer Proctor. Proctor used to be with the band in Lockburn, at Lockburn I believe. There was an all-black outfit and…
